newsitem.title: UK: SMITHKLINE DOWN, TRACKS U.S. SECTOR.
newsitem.headline: SMITHKLINE DOWN, TRACKS U.S. SECTOR.

text.p: Shares in SmithKline Beecham Plc led major British pharmaceutical shares lower on Tuesday, tracking a retreat in the U.S. drug sector.
At 1015 GMT, shares in SmithKline were down 18p to 1123-1/2, bucking the firmer trend in the broad market.
Shares in Zeneca Group Plc sank 21-1/2p to 1942-1/2. Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc eased 15-1/2p to 1272-1/2.
U.S. drug shares stumbled on Monday after Morgan Stanley cut its weighting in the U.S. sector to a "market weighting" from "overweight," dealers said.
The brokerage took similar action a few weeks ago, reducing weightings in the UK and European sectors.
Dealers said Morgan Stanley has turned more cautious about the outlook for the industry globally with major patent expirations looming.
"The momentum seems to be changing, and this may be just the beginning," one market maker said.

In New York, shares in Merck & Co lost $3-9/16 to $95-1/4, shares in Eli Lilly & Co fell $4-1/8 to $108-11/16 and Baxter International Inc eased $1-3/8 to $54-1/2. U.S. drug shares continued lower in London.
